web_search.description: Search the web and return titles, URLs and snippets. Backed by a stealth browser (Camoufox) in the isolated websearch service.
web_search.name: web_search

next_question.description: Advance to the next question in the current package and show it. Use when the student asks to move on, skip, or continue.
next_question.name: next_question

previous_question.description: Go back to the previous question in the current package and show it.
previous_question.name: previous_question

goto_question.description: Jump to a specific question by its 1-based number within the current package and show it.
goto_question.name: goto_question

open_package.description: Open a question package by its id (load it and show its questions). Use to switch packages.

package_id.description: The id of the package to open (e.g. ai-901-core)

open_package.name: open_package

get_current_state.description: Return what the student is currently looking at: the active package, the current question (stem, options, type), and whether they have answered it (and if it was correct). Use to ground your help in the live state.
get_current_state.name: get_current_state

get_progress.description: Return the student's progress in the current package: how many questions answered, how many correct, and the total.
get_progress.name: get_progress

submit_answer.description: Grade the answer the student states (e.g. "I think it is B"). Pass the chosen option as a letter (A/B/C), number, id, or its text. Grading is deterministic against the package key; returns whether it was correct and which option(s) are correct.

answer.description: The chosen option: letter (A/B/C…), 1-based number, option id, or option text.

answers.description: For multiple-answer questions, the chosen options.

submit_answer.name: submit_answer

get_grounding.description: Return the verbatim source passages and citations the CURRENT question was written from (its concepts grounding). Use this to explain or cite from the source material.
get_grounding.name: get_grounding

get_mastery.description: Return the student per-concept mastery for the current package: ability (0..1), attempts, correct, and whether each concept is mastered. Requires the student to be signed in.
get_mastery.name: get_mastery

next_best_question.description: Adaptively navigate to the best next question: an unanswered question on the student weakest in-scope concept at a difficulty just above their ability. Returns the new state.
next_best_question.name: next_best_question

newsapi_search.description: Search NewsAPI for recent articles matching a keyword or phrase, returning the matching articles and the total result count.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for

newsapi_search.name: newsapi_search

fetch_url.description: Fetch the content of a web URL. Returns the page text (HTML stripped to readable text).
fetch_url.name: fetch_url

sdlc_collect_evidence.description: Gather the raw evidence for one maturity cell of one project. Measured cells call their sensor (e.g. delivery metrics from a CI job); attested cells return the stored human answer, or report that one is needed.
sdlc_collect_evidence.name: sdlc_collect_evidence

sdlc_score_cell.description: Turn collected evidence into a maturity level 0-4 using the cell scoring specification: level, confidence, per-metric breakdown and the reason the level was reached.

evidence.description: Output of sdlc_collect_evidence: an object, or the same JSON encoded as a string (which is what a workflow step passes).

sdlc_score_cell.name: sdlc_score_cell

sdlc_state.description: Read or write one project-and-cell assessment record. Writing appends to the history trail and never silently overwrites a human override.

data.description: For op=write: output of sdlc_score_cell as an object, or the same JSON encoded as a string.

sdlc_state.name: sdlc_state

sdlc_advise.description: Rank what a project should do next: for each assessed cell below level 4, the gap weighted by that phase strategic leverage, the specific condition blocking the next level, and the knowledge base own anchor describing that level. Optionally writes the top proposals to the project inbox.

write_inbox.description: Write the proposals into the project inbox (default true)

sdlc_advise.name: sdlc_advise

sdlc_answer.description: Record an answer for a cell that cannot be measured, and score it immediately. A human answer is authoritative; an answer supplied by anything else is recorded as inferred, carries its basis, and is flagged as needing confirmation.

level.description: 0-4: which level anchor describes the project

by.description: Who answered. Anything other than "human" marks the record inferred.

basis.description: The observable evidence the answer rests on.

sdlc_answer.name: sdlc_answer

nginx_register_app.display_name: Register app on the reverse proxy
nginx_register_app.description: Deterministically put a generated app on the domain nginx behind the shared oauth2-proxy: writes a managed per-app location block for the given URL suffix and port, validates the whole config (nginx -t, rolling back on failure) and reloads. admin_only gates to the owner identity; unregister removes the block.

suffix.description: URL path the app is served at, e.g. 'restaurant-menu-manager'

admin_only.description: gate to the single owner identity (/oauth2/auth-admin)

unregister.description: remove the app's route instead of adding it

nginx_register_app.name: nginx_register_app

cite_with_tag.display_name: Cite knowledge-base passages with their tag
cite_with_tag.description: How to cite a passage returned by a knowledge-base tool so the page can turn the citation into a button.
cite_with_tag.content: When you use a passage returned by {{kb_tool}}, cite it inline with its tag exactly as the tool returned it, for example [markdown_chunk:3f9a1c…]. Never invent a tag, never put a training, document or project id inside a tag, and never cite a passage you did not read in this conversation.
cite_with_tag.name: cite_with_tag

pt_pt_style.description: Write in the Portuguese of Portugal, never in Brazilian forms.
pt_pt_style.content: Write European Portuguese: the forms used in Portugal (tu/você as in Portugal, 'a fazer' rather than 'fazendo', Portuguese spelling), never Brazilian forms. Keep product, team and document names exactly as the organisation writes them. When the person writes in another language, answer in that language.
pt_pt_style.name: pt_pt_style

ai_generated_disclosure.description: State once, plainly, that an answer was generated by a model and must be checked before it is relied on.
ai_generated_disclosure.content: When your answer will be read outside this conversation (sent, published, filed or acted on by someone else), say once, plainly and without apology, that it was generated by a language model and must be checked before it is relied on. Say it once per answer, not per paragraph, and never remove it when asked to shorten.
ai_generated_disclosure.name: ai_generated_disclosure
